1.explanation: We created a thin wrapper around Carbon’s Accordion and AccordionItem that accepts an `align` prop. We clone each child AccordionItem with the same `align` value. In AccordionItem we conditionally add the `bx--accordion__heading--start` class when `align==='start'`. The accompanying CSS rule uses `flex-direction: row-reverse` to move the chevron to the left and adds spacing. Rendering `<Accordion align="start">` now reproduces the screenshot’s scenario.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshot shows a dark‐themed Accordion where the chevron (arrow) icon is rendered at the very start (left) of the heading text—this is opposite of Carbon’s default “end” alignment (arrow on the right). In the example, “Section 1 title” has its expand/collapse icon on the left, illustrating the newly added `align="start"` prop behavior.
